description: Measures intensity of positive and negative affect using 10 items each. Higher arousal focus.
relation_to_spane: SPANE measures frequency (not intensity) with fewer items; both assess positive/negative affect. SPANE has better cross-cultural validity.
when_to_use: When you need to measure affect INTENSITY rather than frequency

description: Measures global cognitive judgment of life satisfaction. Single-factor scale.
relation_to_spane: SPANE correlates strongly with SWLS (r=.65); together they assess emotional AND cognitive well-being. SPANE measures affect; SWLS measures cognition.
when_to_use: When you need cognitive evaluation of life satisfaction

description: Measures psychological flourishing: positive relationships competence meaning purpose.
relation_to_spane: SPANE captures the emotional component; FS captures eudaimonic functioning. Often used together in well-being batteries.
when_to_use: When you need to assess psychological functioning beyond emotions

description: Measures five elements of well-being: Positive emotion Engagement Relationships Meaning Accomplishment.
relation_to_spane: SPANE measures the 'P' (Positive Emotion) component of PERMA. Can be used alongside PERMA for comprehensive assessment.
when_to_use: When you need a broad well-being framework

description: Measures emotional psychological and social well-being. Categorical diagnosis of flourishing languishing.
relation_to_spane: SPANE focuses on emotional well-being (affect frequency); MHC-SF covers all three domains of Keyes' model.
when_to_use: When you need comprehensive mental health assessment

description: Measures global subjective happiness via self-report. Brief 4-item scale.
relation_to_spane: SPANE is more comprehensive (12 items vs 4) and separates positive/negative affect. SHS is a single global happiness score.
when_to_use: When you need a very brief global happiness measure

description: Measures personal happiness via cognitive and affective items. Longer instrument.
relation_to_spane: SPANE is briefer and focuses specifically on affect frequency. OHQ includes broader life evaluation items.
when_to_use: When you need a comprehensive happiness inventory

description: Measures mental well-being: positive affect relationships functioning.
relation_to_spane: SPANE is shorter (12 vs 14 items) and explicitly separates positive/negative affect. WEMWBS is a single well-being score.
when_to_use: When you need a validated population well-being measure

description: Measures general well-being across multiple dimensions in Spanish-speaking populations.
relation_to_spane: SPANE has been validated alongside SGWB in Latin American studies. SPANE is more focused on affect frequency.

description: Classic measure of psychological well-being via positive/negative affect balance.
relation_to_spane: SPANE is the modern successor: more items better psychometrics broader emotion coverage validated across cultures.
when_to_use: When you need a modern replacement for Bradburn's classic scale
